title: IBM watsonx.data 2.4.0 through 2.4.0 patch 8 could allow unauthorized network access due to… (CVE-2026-14880)
description: IBM watsonx.data versions 2.4.0 through 2.4.0 patch 8 contain a vulnerability that could allow unauthorized network access due to insufficient network segmentation controls. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.3. No public exploits or known active exploitation have been reported. No patch or remediation details are provided in the available data.
